Why going to bed at 11:30 PM steals up to +2.6 inches (+6.7 cm) of your child's predicted adult height 📏🧬

According to pediatric endocrinology studies (JCEM), 70% of daily pulsatile Human Growth Hormone (HGH) is secreted during deep Slow-Wave Sleep (SWS) between 10:00 PM and 2:00 AM.

✅ 3 Rules to Unlock the +2.6 in Window:
1️⃣ Lights out by 10:00 PM (Ages 6–12) / 9:00 PM (Ages 3–5)
2️⃣ Zero sugary snacks or carbs 2 hours before sleep (insulin blunts HGH!)
3️⃣ Morning Vitamin D3 + K2 + Chelated Zinc for IGF-1 bone mineralization
